يتعرقبون (form IIq)
# يَتَعَرْقَبُونَ (yataʕarqabūna) /ja.ta.ʕar.qa.buː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of تَعَرْقَبَ (taʕarqaba)
# يُتَعَرْقَبُونَ (yutaʕarqabūna) /ju.ta.ʕar.qa.buː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of تَعَرْقَبَ (taʕarqaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
